goals: Give structurally eligible dry upward- and ceiling-supported foliage directional canonical-parent placement and survival parity on exact native horizontal Nibaru slabs while preserving vanilla block/state identity, lifecycle, growth, harvesting, cleanup, and coherent half-height geometry.

Delegate bonemeal on exact dry bottom native Nibaru slabs for canonical Grass Block, Moss Block, and Pale Moss Block through the corresponding Minecraft 26.2 substrate implementation without broadening material or geometry ownership.
scope: Maintain C6 as the directional canonical-parent successor to C5: resolve exact BGE native or explicitly profile-owned effective horizontal slabs, substitute only the support below an upward root or above a ceiling anchor with the profile's canonical parent in a read-only LevelReader projection, and let ordinary Minecraft canSurvive make the permission decision.

Classify behavior structurally through the retained upward-family contracts, concrete Minecraft 26.2 HangingRootsBlock and SporeBlossomBlock contracts, HangingMossBlock, and generic downward GrowingPlantBlock head/body pairs with Direction.DOWN; exact connected-column resolution lets compatible modded plants such as Mynx × Regions Unexplored dropleaf inherit the generic contract without a registry-ID exception or production dependency.

Resolve every downward-growing head/body or hanging-moss segment to one actual top anchor, preserve the real neighboring column, project only the anchor's support above, and apply one coherent directional offset without shifted persisted positions or replacement blocks.

Align accepted ceiling foliage under top slabs by exactly +0.5 Y and accepted upward foliage over bottom slabs by exactly -0.5 Y across models, outlines, targeting, cached/context collision, visual, interaction, entity-inside, breaking-overlay, and shape-derived particle geometry; bottom/double ceiling supports and top/double upward supports remain unshifted.

Preserve exact C4 as historical predecessor provenance and preserve the bounded Grass Block, Moss Block, and Pale Moss Block substrate-bonemeal behavior inherited from C3, including exact item consumption, native-slab restoration/reconciliation, generated vegetation positioning, and lowered-azalea safety.

Use exact unified BGE C70, CNM 2.0.7, Terrain Slabs 3.3.2, Java 25, Gradle 9.5.1, Loom 1.17.19, and Fabric API 0.157.0+26.2 only as controlled build/test or read-only comparison baselines; runtime dependency eligibility remains capability/provider-based.

exclusions: Crop/farmland families, ordinary and attached stems, saplings, giant-fungus starters, lily pads, and fluid-dependent or aquatic plants fail closed through behavior-class boundaries; PitcherCropBlock is included in the crop boundary because its farmland lifecycle is a DoublePlantBlock rather than a CropBlock.

Bottom-slab mushroom and azalea bonemeal transformation into larger structures fails closed because the generated structure cannot preserve equivalent half-height geometry; ordinary small-mushroom spread and accepted azalea decoration remain supported.

Vertical slabs, CNM Steps, layers, stairs, walls, columns, vanilla or foreign slabs, side-mounted plants, glow lichen, rails, redstone components, pressure plates, torches, lanterns, chains, pointed dripstone, machinery, arbitrary decorations, upward-growing vine columns, and aquatic growing plants receive no new ceiling projection.

The read-only projection supports ordinary BlockGetter and LevelReader placement/survival contracts. Raw ChunkAccess inspection is delegated and arbitrary custom placement systems that bypass those world-view accessors are not claimed compatible.

Unified Block Geometry Extensions retains canonical material/native-slab ownership; this project adds no duplicate plant blocks, persisted offset property, registry-name parser, competing material table, standalone Nibaru dependency, or hard Mynx × Regions Unexplored dependency.

No Test Slot, Test Instance Manager state, accepted stack, Minecraft profile, deployment, gameplay runtime result, or promotion is changed by C5 controlled validation; the protected gameplay instance remains off-limits.

state.milestone: C6 is the focused C5 runtime-fix successor. Its optional Sodium LevelSlice snapshot bridge supplies the owning ClientLevel to the same read-only render offset projection used by vanilla RenderSectionRegion snapshots, while BGE C70 explicitly assigns minecraft:stone_slab to Stone's profile and C6 accepts that exact effective source only when no native BGE slab exists. C5 user-reported failures are preserved: RU Tassel/Clover appeared about 0.5 high, ceiling foliage about 0.5 low, and Cave Vines/RU Dropleaf placed under full Stone but not its slab; no broader RU claim is inferred. Java 25 controlled validation passed 5/5 JUnit tests and 30 server GameTests, but client rendering, RU fixture behavior, and real save/reload remain untested. C6 is ACTIVE, NOT_DEPLOYED, RUNTIME_UNTESTED, and unaccepted.

current.summary: Fixes client render offsets and native BGE slab compatibility for directional foliage on horizontal slabs.
